description_en: Associates a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) APP instance with another enterprise code
description_zh: 调用UpdateSmartAGEnterpriseCode更换智能接入网关APP实例绑定的企业码
kebab_example: aliyun smartag update-smart-ag-enterprise-code --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --enterprise-code 12P00 --smart-ag-id sag-rz2e23c0e78ema0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSmartAGEnterpriseCode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG APP instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关APP实例所属地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The enterprise code with you want to associate the SAG APP instance
parameters.name: enterprise_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG APP instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
